scout.productSummary: An electronics supply-chain optimizer for component procurement, built on a frozen 2024 market-data snapshot (791 components, 92 distributors, 8,176 price offers). Core is an OR-Tools CP-SAT sourcing MILP plus a two-stage stochastic program producing a cost-vs-CVaR-95 efficient frontier, with forecasting benchmarks and a 50-gate model CI suite. Every headline figure is produced by a command in the repo and written to a committed JSON artifact; tests regenerate the documents' GENERATED regions from those artifacts so published numbers cannot drift from the runs behind them.
currentGoals: Every published number matches its committed artifact: stale README leakage R², INTERMITTENT_DEMAND.md §9 'not built', landing hero crediting Prophet for Chronos's result
Fix anything broken, most visible first: the live-demo path a recruiter walks (demo login 403s on the cart), then everything else
Make the guards on published numbers able to fail and actually run: CI's 'not slow' deselect, deploy shipping the branch tip not the gated SHA, the 'or True' assertion
Publish docs/newsvendor.json as a rendered doc, always naming the baseline (36.26% vs all-zero forecast, 4.01% vs scarf_minmax)
New ideas that let an OR/forecasting/supply-chain recruiter try the strongest true results on the live site, built only on the real snapshot
A proposal that would move a resume figure (387 solves, $4.27 per $1, Brier 0.393, rank 1.66) is allowed, but its title starts with [resume-figure] and its body has a before/after table
offLimits: Hand-editing GENERATED regions, docs/*.json artifacts, metrics.joblib or provenance stamps; regenerate from a clean tree instead
Synthetic, fabricated or live data replacing the frozen 2024 snapshot, or drift in backend/seeds/data
Skipping, deselecting or loosening any test or gate to get green
Claims on the do-not-claim lists, or any percentage without its baseline
Loop machinery: claude-*.yml, loop-metrics, .github/loop-config.json, the docs/archive/loop-brief.md path
Hosting or plan changes, an AWS move, spending money, credentials, key rotation, git history rewrites; never put a secret or key prefix in an issue
CLAUDE.md, LEARNINGS.md, .claude/, docs/handoffs/; LICENSE text and the CC-BY-4.0 attribution
lenses: Published-claim integrity: a number or statement on a page, the README or a doc that its committed artifact, the served DB or the live API contradicts.
Checks that cannot fail: a test, CI filter or deploy step that would stay green if the thing it guards broke.
Recruiter's first minute: what someone opening the live site or README sees first, and where it breaks, misleads or buries the strongest true result.
Worth building next: a feature that lets a recruiter or procurement user try the strongest true result themselves, using only the real snapshot.
